# automox_device_group_assignment (Resource)

Places an existing Automox device into a server group.

Automox normally assigns a device's group when its agent installs, and the console lets a device's group change at any time. This resource exists for a device that already has the agent installed and needs to move into a group Terraform manages, without reinstalling it and without moving it by hand in the console -- either of which would be invisible to Terraform and show up as drift the next time something else touches the device.

Destroying this resource does **not** move the device back to its previous group, including the organization's default group. It only removes the assignment from Terraform state. A destroy that silently returned a fleet of devices to an unpatched default group would be far more dangerous than one that leaves them exactly where they were.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# automox_device_group_assignment moves a device that already has the agent
# installed into a group Terraform manages, without reinstalling the agent and
# without moving it by hand in the console.

resource "automox_server_group" "pos_ring_1" {
  name                   = "POS Ring 1"
  refresh_interval       = 1440
  parent_server_group_id = 230685
}

resource "automox_device_group_assignment" "register_1" {
  # The Automox server ID of a device the agent already registered.
  device_id       = 5818967
  server_group_id = automox_server_group.pos_ring_1.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) The Automox server ID of the device to place in a group. Forces replacement: this resource is keyed to one device record, not a name or a filter, so a changed `device_id` means managing a different assignment rather than updating this one.
- `server_group_id` (Number) The Automox server group ID the device should belong to. Changing this moves the device again; it does not replace the resource.

### Read-Only

- `organization_id` (Number) Organization this device belongs to, resolved from the provider's `organization_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Device group assignments import by the device's integer Automox server ID.
terraform import automox_device_group_assignment.register_1 5818967
```
